content: Hello, this is Career Support. How can I assist you with your concerns today?
Hi, I'm feeling stuck with the online training platform I signed up for. It's not working as I expected.
I completely understand how that can be frustrating. I reassure you that we will work through this together and find a solution that suits your needs.
That's good to hear. I just don't want to waste time or money on something that doesn't help me.
Don't worry, your progress and investment are important to us. You can trust me to guide you step-by-step and ensure you get the best out of the program.
Thanks, I appreciate that. What's the best way to start fixing this?
First, we'll identify where the platform isn't meeting your expectations. From there, I'll support you with tailored recommendations and resources to get you back on track.
